In which currency can I purchase licenses or items in CLO-SET CONNECT?
All licenses and items from CLO-SET CONNECT can only be purchased in USD. If you are using foreign currency, it will be exchanged for USD when the amount is charged.

I use a 2D CAD system from another software company. Can I still use CLO?
Yes, as long as the 2D CAD patterns are exported in DXF-AAMA or DXF-ASTM format, they can be imported into CLO.

Yes, your device must be connected to the internet when you log in to access CLO. Please note that CLO for Individuals, a subscription-based plan, cannot be used offline.

What kind of licenses do you offer?

CLO offers different license types to meet everyone's needs. CLO for Individuals CLO for Individuals is for individual users only, including students, freelancers, and one-person business owners. Any legal entities with two or more employees, including the CEO, are strictly prohibited from using CLO for Individuals. There are monthly and annual subscriptions available for CLO for Individuals. CLO for Business CLO for Business with enhanced services tailored from a small to large-scale business. If you would like more detailed information such as pricing, support range, and training about CLO for Business, please reach out to CLO via Contact Us. CLO for Academic CLO for Academic is a special license for academic institutions. For more information about CLO for Education, please reach out to CLO via Contact Us.

Why am I getting a misuse notification pop-up on CLO software?

Under our Terms or Policy, any misused Individual Licenses are technically subject to immediate suspension or termination at the sole discretion of our Legal Department. Here is a friendly reminder: CLO Terms require any business with more than one full-time employee to purchase an Enterprise License. Individual Licenses are reserved for personal hobbyists, freelancers, and one-person companies. The documents must prove that they registered as a one-person company or freelancer. To avoid any unnecessary interruption to your business and CLO software access, please reach out via Contact Us to let us know about your companys structure with proven documentation. Our team will follow up as soon as possible to guide you to further steps.

I get the pop-up about the suspension of Individual plan. What should I do?

If you see this pop-up and watermark on your CLO screen, this means you are potentially in violation of CLO license policy and are belonging to one of the following: a member of an entity that has at least one(1) full-time employee other than you. making purchases of our Services or CLO Software using a corporate credit card. registering for a CLO account using a corporate email account, corporate email address, or corporate domain name. accessing the CLO Software through a computer owned by an Enterprise/Academic entity. Please note that the eligibility of Individual plan is a one-person company, a sole proprietorship, a single-member LLC that does not elect to be treated as a corporation for tax purposes (disregarded entity), a freelancer, a self-employed independent contractor, or similarly situated self-employee otherwise in business for yourself. To remove the suspension for Individual subscription, you need to be verified through independent documentation such as articles of incorporation, business registration, tax returns/filings, proof of Self-Employment Tax payment, etc. Please contact us with your account and corresponsive documentation.

What is the difference between CLO for Individual and CLO for Enterprise?

The licensing policies, features, and services are divided based on user types. CLO for Individual is strictly for individual personal use ( e.g. as a hobby) or individual commercial use (e.g. as an individual freelancer, a one-person company, sole proprietor, etc). Any company with more than one employee must use CLO for Business. Please refer to the compared plans at the bottom of the plans page.

Can I use CLO's default Motion files for body-scanned Avatars?

To use CLO's default Motion files for body-scanned Avatars, an advanced configuration so called "Rigging" must be performed and the Rigging structure of the body-scanned Avatars and CLO's default Motion files' Rigging structure must be exactly the same.

Can I use my own accessories (hair, shoes, etc.) for CLO Avatars?

You may import personal accessories into CLO as OBJ, FBX and other 3D file types, but they won't be automatically placed where the Avatar's hair or shoes is. To use personal accessories as CLO's hair and shoes, some advanced configuration need to be made in other 3D tools such as Maya. If you would like to use accessories other than default items, please check out CLO-SET CONNECT.

Is it possible to have an Avatar that has the exact specs as my fit model?

Yes. You may modify and use the default Avatar if the Avatar's size can be approximately the same as your fit model. Also, you may purchase an Avatar similar to your fit model in CLO-SET CONNECT. However, you need to customize your Avatar through 3D modeling companies if the Avatar's size needs to be exactly the same as your fit model. If you would like to customize your Avatar, please contact the CLO Global Support Team.

Is it OK to use non-genuine CLO software?

CLO Virtual Fashion Inc. does not approve the supply or use of non-genuine CLO software, and it is not OK. Furthermore, spyware and viruses can be spread using non-genuine CLO software. According to IDC, firms that receive or install unauthorized software or purchase a computer with unlicensed software have a one-in-three probability of encountering malware (29 percent). To protect you against non-genuine CLO software, please purchase from clo3d.com or an authorized reseller to ensure that you are getting authentic CLO software. CLO works hard to keep you safe from fraudulent sellers by ensuring that only genuine CLO software is available for purchase.

The patterns are deformed when I import my DXF file into CLO. How can I fix the problem?

The problem may occur when creating a pattern from 2D CAD software. Please firstly check two things below: If a sewing line or a cutting line of a pattern is made as 'Baseline' from 2D CAD program: If a pattern is created with 'Baselines' from 2D CAD program, the pattern might not be compatible with CLO. For patterns to be imported into CLO, it is recommended to create it with 'Outlines' instead of 'Baselines'. If a pattern is created as an unclosed shape from 2D CAD program: If a pattern is created as an unclosed shape from 2D CAD program, it might not be compatible with CLO. The feature named 'Swap Cutting line and Sewing line' is for importing a pattern into CLO by swapping sewing lines and cutting lines. However, as for patterns created as an unclosed shape, some of the patterns may be deformed when imported into CLO with 'Swap Cutting line and Sewing line'. Thus, please firstly make sure whether a pattern is created as an unclosed shape or not. And if the former, modify the pattern to a closed shape and try to import it into CLO again.

How can I join CLO Discord?

Account Creation Go to https://discord.com/ Create an account Choose how you want to access Discord Option 1: Choose to download the Discord app for your desktop Option 2: Choose to access Discord in your browser Joining the CLO Discord Server Copy the CLO Discord server invitation link to your Clipboard https://bit.ly/CLOOFFICIAL Open the Discord Desktop App Click on the Add a Server Button on the left side of the interface In the Create a Server Pop-up, Click Join a Server at the bottom Paste the server link in the Invite Link field, then click Join Server The CLO icon will now appear on the left side of your interface. Go to the Notice channels on the left side. Please read the Rules and Read me First text channels Go to the Self-Roles channel and react with the blue dot to gain full access to all of the CLO channels You will now see all of the different CLO text channels. Happy CLOing!
